run_sketch_mode: run the ContributorAgent in sketch mode to create initial Lean file structure from source tex
run_prove_mode: run the ContributorAgent in prove mode to prove a specific assigned theorem in Lean
run_maintain_mode: run the ContributorAgent in maintain mode to pick up issues and add API or refactor code
run_scan_mode: run the ContributorAgent in scan mode to find architectural issues and create issues in the issues folder
run_triage_mode: run the ContributorAgent in triage mode to detect resolved issues and close them
